name: Greymarrow Detach-Panel Night Ops Set
description: Everything about this set is designed to change. The primary jacket is a hip-length blouson in matte grey-brown — the color of unpainted ferrocrete, utterly unremarkable — with four snap-off exterior panels: two chest, two shoulder. Each panel swaps out independently, and a runner carrying a small pouch of alternates can change the jacket's visible silhouette and color blocking in under ninety seconds. The base jacket beneath the panels is plain enough to wear alone. Inside, a double-wall front panel conceals a rigid holster frame that can be reconfigured for two compacts, one full-frame, or a row of tool loops. The back yoke has a full spinal channel — a wide open-seam corridor running from collar to hem that accommodates external spinal rig hardware, closing around it with a series of silent magnetic tabs. Gene-compatible rear venting panels accommodate non-functional wings or large dorsal geneware modifications with snap-bar expansion. Paired trousers are in near-black slate with a maroon pinstripe too subtle to read at distance — Tier 2 enough to vanish in a crowd, Tier 3 enough to enter a building lobby. Thigh zip pockets are scanner-lined to mask small metal objects from passive detection. Footwear is a flat-soled runner's shoe in dark graphite synthetic mesh over a hard composite plate, lace-free with a single diagonal strap closure. A thin balaclava in matching grey-brown microfibre is folded in the inside collar pocket — full face cover in two seconds, gone in three.
functionality: Interchangeable snap-off exterior panels for rapid silhouette change; reconfigurable internal holster frame; magnetic-tab spinal rig channel (full back accommodation); gene-compatible dorsal expansion panels for wing or large geneware; scanner-lined thigh pockets; Tier 2-3 crowd-compatible trouser aesthetic; stored balaclava in collar pocket; lace-free fast footwear
what_it_says: This is a professional who learned from a job that went wrong because they were too recognizable. Everything about this set is designed to be different five minutes later. The maroon pinstripe in the trousers is the only vanity — a runner's private joke that they're still themselves underneath all the adaptations.
worn_by: operatives who work the same area repeatedly and need to vary their appearance
manufacturer: Greymarrow Fab — unlicensed, Shelf-adjacent workshop, known for modular construction
story_hooks: A runner's panel pouch is lost during an early chase, leaving them locked into one visible configuration for the rest of a multi-stage job where they need to appear as two different people.
The scanner-lined thigh pockets are old stock — a newer passive scanner at the checkpoint reads right through them, flagging the ceramic blade inside.
A spinal rig user's magnetic tabs start responding to an electromagnetic pulse deployed by security, causing the back channel to seal shut around the hardware mid-movement.
